'''Finn Tegotash''' was a member of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref>. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he was present during the time that the gang held [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] prisoner.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref> [[20 BBY/Legends|Two years later]],<ref name="BBY">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' (2014)]] [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 44|Part 44]] {{C|20 BBY 47–50, ''Maul on Mandalore''}}</ref> Finn fought in a [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|skirmish]] after many of Hondo's pirates joined [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] in their conquest for power. Finn attempted to defend [[Hondo's complex/Legends|Ohnaka's outpost]], but was shot to death by one of Maul's defected pirates.<ref name="REV">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
He wore very simple clothing, consisting of a drab beige top and plain blue pants; as well as standard boots.<ref name=":0" />
